requirements.note: launcher/runner exit and window hide use 3 monitor intervals + 1 failure window (3 x 10s); login idle uses startup grace 90s + 3 intervals; each scenario ran on a fresh QA volume

flaky_tests.finding: no fixed sleeps as synchronization: every wait is a deadline-bounded state predicate; the observation windows are time-as-behavior and the asserted minimum is checked against the measured elapsed seconds

hung_commands.finding: every docker exec/logs/events/curl/python call is wrapped in timeout; all loops carry a deadline

stale_state.finding: prep_fresh removes any QA-owned container/volume first: every scenario starts on a fresh QA volume (and fresh runtime-state/budget)

misleading_success_output.finding: a pass needs probe ready AND HTTP 200 AND an independent WebSocket RFB banner in EVERY sample, plus pid-set equality and the monitor own recovery_count/budget; a quiet log alone is never accepted
